title: Drumm's evaluation of the Biondi team's papers

tellings.quote: My original stance when I started looking at this back in 2020 when I was evaluating their original paper was about 50/50.

plain: The researcher Geoffrey Drumm says that when he first studied a team's 2020 paper on hidden structures under the Giza plateau in Egypt, he gave it about even odds of being right. The team is led by a scientist named Filippo Biondi, and they later wrote a second paper on the Khafre pyramid. Drumm tells Michels this as his own reading of the papers, as a way of showing how his view of their claims has changed since 2020.
